scripts.preinstall: if [ -n "$npm_config_user_agent" ]; then echo "$npm_config_user_agent" | grep -q '^pnpm/' || (echo 'Use pnpm instead' && exit 1); fi
scripts.build: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm -r --if-present run build
scripts.typecheck: pnpm run typecheck:libs && pnpm -r --filter "./apps/**" --filter "./scripts" --if-present run typecheck
